resources.string: Use pure-colour rotation to detect screen failures and card points
Click to change the colour. ..the right and left slide can be switched back and forth.
How do we detect the damage?

The screen will display five solid colors in sequence: white, black, red, green, and blue.

• White background: check for black dark spots (dead pixels)
• Black background: check for bright spots (stuck pixels)
• Colored backgrounds: check for abnormal pixels in other colors

Tap the screen to switch to the next color, or enable auto-play. For the best results, perform the test in a dim environment.
